title: NHKマイルカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So this is a G1 race… There's definitely a unique atmosphere here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I think I'll be fine though. We only had dirt tracks back in Kasamatsu, but I ran miles all the time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I like short-distance races. It's nice not having to worry about anything other than running.
